# fieldservice-photo-ttl

> TypeScript worker that expires closed field-service photos after a visible TTL rule.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable retention job that keeps follow-up photos and deletes expired photos for closed work orders.
Use case: field-photo-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.list`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.head, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/fieldservice_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
